claim: Every path that returns from a non-play screen to a sprite-drawn screen must switch the layers back on, and menus and end screens may hold their own plots that need the overlay shown there too.

evidence.text: The pause menu stub restores NEXTREG 0x15 and 0x69 on return; e_scr also turns Layer 2 on in case the menu is left without its RET. Checked in MAME.
evidence.quote: on too, in case the menu is left without its RET. Checked in MAME by the contributor (2026-10-13).

evidence.text: On non-play screens the alt-ROM stubs write NextReg $15 = 0 (sprites off) and the next commit sets $15 = 1.
evidence.quote: off), then the original call. The next commit sets $15 = 1.

evidence.text: Menu icons painted in the colour set were missing until the overlay was shown on the menu; sweep menus and end screens too, not only play.
evidence.quote: its painted icons were missing until the overlay was shown there. Sweep menus and end screens too, not only play.
